newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says deficit problem a long haul.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says deficit problem a long haul.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday October balance of payments data released earlier showed net income requirements have increased.

"With the servicing requirements that Australia now has, it's going to be a long haul in relation to the balance of payments...It's going to take a long haul to address this problem," Costello told reporters.
Costello noted the balance of payments data for the four months to October had improved significantly over the same period a year ago.
Figures released earlier on Friday showed Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.788 billion in October from September's deficit of A$1.690 billion.
The net income deficit, which measures capital flows such as payments on Australia's foreign debt, widened to A$1.910 billion in October from A$1.759 billion in September.
